name: redline
description: Pull and act on UI redlines captured by the Redline Chrome extension via a local HTTP sidecar.

interface.shortDescription: Highlight live web UI, leave redlines, pipe them into Codex.
interface.longDescription: Pulls UI redlines captured in the browser by the Redline Chrome extension into Codex sessions. Manages the local HTTP sidecar daemon (start/stop/status) and exposes a skill that fetches, locates, and applies redlines against the source code.
defaultPrompt: Apply the feedback I left on the page.
